about: Intentional exceptions to the HST dialog layout rulebook (tests/unit/test_ui_layout_rulebook.py). Each entry: file, rule (min-gap, row-gap, list-gap, label-height, ellipsize), container id (or * for the whole file), optional between (the pair, for anonymous containers), reason. No entry without a reason; an entry that no longer matches a finding fails the test.
